gaps.title: Checkbox and radio size apart from density
gaps.note: GOV.UK checkboxes and radios are 40px (2px #0b0c0c edge; the radio's checked dot 20px), beside 40px fields and 38px buttons

gaps.title: Button inline padding apart from height
gaps.note: GOV.UK buttons pad 10px inline (8px top, 7px bottom) at 38px over a 2px lip, at 19/400
gaps.standin: 16px at `density: spacious`; `comfortable` pads 10px but shrinks tabs and pagination further (63 off against 65)

gaps.title: Narrower field inset
gaps.note: GOV.UK fields and selects pad 5px inline inside a 2px edge, at 40px

gaps.title: Tab height apart from density
gaps.note: GOV.UK tabs are 45px #f3f3f3 plates; the current tab 56px, stepping 1px onto the panel's edge
gaps.standin: 33px, the current chip 31px, on a segmented track

gaps.title: Tab padding apart from density
gaps.note: GOV.UK tabs pad 20px inline (19px plus a 1px edge on the current one)

gaps.title: Badge size apart from density
gaps.note: GOV.UK tags are 30px tall with 8px padding at 19px

gaps.title: Pagination item size
gaps.note: GOV.UK's current page is 45px tall with 15px inline padding around a 19/700 numeral

gaps.title: Body text size apart from density
gaps.note: GOV.UK sets 19px for body copy, hints, labels, field values, buttons, tabs and tags alike (16px in the header, footer and tables on small screens)
gaps.standin: 16px body, 14px controls and hints at `density: spacious`

gaps.title: Field label size
gaps.note: GOV.UK field labels are 19/400 like the body; page-heading labels take the heading size

gaps.title: Heading sizes on their own scale
gaps.note: GOV.UK headings run 48 / 36 / 24 / 19px at 700 (govuk-heading-xl/l/m/s); guides use 48 for the page title, 24 for h2 and 19 for h3

gaps.title: Badge label weight and size
gaps.note: GOV.UK tags are 19/400 in sentence case since v5

gaps.title: Inline links at the body weight
gaps.note: GOV.UK links are 19/400 in #1a65a6, underlined, the same weight as the copy around them

gaps.title: Bold only where pagination leads
gaps.note: GOV.UK's current page is 19/700 white on #1a65a6; Previous and Next are 700, the other numbers 19/400

gaps.title: Table header labels at 700
gaps.note: GOV.UK table headers are 19/700 in #0b0c0c over 1px #cecece rules; row headers too
gaps.standin: `tableHeaderLabel: strong`, full ink at regular weight

gaps.title: Accordion titles in bold
gaps.note: GOV.UK accordion section titles are 24/700 (19/700 on small screens)

gaps.title: A ledge secondary on a gray plate
gaps.note: GOV.UK's secondary is a #f3f3f3 plate under #0b0c0c on a 2px #858686 lip, with no edge
gaps.standin: Ledge's secondary: the page fill in a 2px gray edge over a gray lip (closed styles own the secondary)

gaps.title: Checked checkboxes keep a clear box
gaps.note: GOV.UK draws the tick in #0b0c0c on the white 40px box and keeps its 2px edge
gaps.standin: a box filled in ink with a white tick (`checkboxColor: neutral`)

gaps.title: Neutral tags at a strong tint
gaps.note: GOV.UK's grey tag is #cecece under #0b0c0c

gaps.title: Links and selection in a second accent, apart from the button brand
gaps.note: GOV.UK links (#1a65a6), the current page, the service navigation's current item and the default tag (#d2e2f1 under #0f385c) are blue beside the green #0f7a52 buttons
gaps.standin: `selectionSeed: #1a65a6` for the current page and selected toggles; links underlined in ink (`linkColor: neutral`); the accent tag tints the green brand

gaps.title: Tab ink at rest
gaps.note: GOV.UK tab labels rest in full ink #0b0c0c, underlined, on their #f3f3f3 plates

gaps.title: An info status seed
gaps.note: GOV.UK's notification banner and default tag are the brand blue #1d70b8

gaps.title: Quiet actions drawn as links
gaps.note: GOV.UK draws tertiary actions as underlined #1a65a6 links at 19/400, the button styled as a link (Show 3 more topics) and Cancel beside a button; its only buttons are the green primary, the grey secondary and the red warning
gaps.standin: the ghost button: plain ink text, no underline, no fill at rest (Resend code, Deny, Remove, Manage plan on the 2026-10-27 review)

gaps.title: Focus as a fill
gaps.note: Focused GOV.UK buttons turn #ffdd00 under #0b0c0c text with a black lip (`0 2px 0 #0b0c0c`), and links fill #ffdd00 over a black bar (`0 -2px #ffdd00, 0 4px #0b0c0c`), with no ring
gaps.standin: a 3px #ffdd00 ring flush around the control (`focusColor: custom`, `focusRingGap: 0`)

gaps.title: Focused field keeps an ink edge under the ring
gaps.note: Focused GOV.UK fields thicken their 2px #0b0c0c edge to 4px (an inset shadow) under the 3px #ffdd00 outline; checkboxes and radios do the same with a 3px yellow shadow
gaps.standin: the field edge turns #ffdd00 too, so the focus reads as 5px of yellow

gaps.title: Invalid fields keep the label's ink
gaps.note: On error GOV.UK keeps the label black, puts a bold #ca3535 message above the field and a 5px #ca3535 rule down the form group; the field edge turns #ca3535
gaps.standin: the label and the message under the field turn red (`invalidStyle: edge`, `inputError: plain`)

gaps.title: Folder tabs
gaps.note: GOV.UK's tabs are #f3f3f3 plates 5px apart; the current one is white in a 1px #cecece top, right and left edge, stepping 1px onto the panel's top edge so tab and panel join. The registry's `enclosed` tabs variant is close, but no `tabStyle` option reaches it
gaps.standin: a white chip in a 2px ring on a gray segmented track (`segmentedSelected: ring`)

gaps.title: Banners with a solid status header
gaps.note: GOV.UK's notification banner is a 5px #1d70b8 frame whose title sits on a #1d70b8 band over a white body; the success banner is the same frame in green and the error summary a 5px #ca3535 frame with no band
gaps.standin: `alertStyle: outline`, a 1px edge and no band

gaps.title: Tables with no outer frame
gaps.note: GOV.UK tables have no frame, only 1px #cecece rules under each row

gaps.title: Accordion marker under the title
gaps.note: GOV.UK accordions put a circled chevron and a Show / Hide link under each section title, at the start, with Show all sections above; a 1px #cecece rule above every section and below the last
gaps.standin: `accordionMarker: leading-caret`, a bare chevron before the title

gaps.title: A brand header bar over every page
gaps.note: Every gov.uk page opens on a 61px #1d70b8 header bar: the white GOV.UK wordmark, Menu at 16/700 in white and the search toggle; the footer is a pale #f4f8fb band under a 10px #1d70b8 top rule
gaps.standin: the blocks' app headers and sidebars sit on the white page (`shellTone: page`)

gaps.title: Ledge depth apart from Chunky's
gaps.note: GOV.UK buttons stand on a 2px lip (`0 2px 0`): #083d29 under the green, #858686 under the secondary; pressed, the button drops 2px and the lip goes
gaps.standin: Chunky's ledge, a 4px lip on the primary

gaps.title: Light-mode ink lightness
gaps.note: GOV.UK text black #0b0c0c (oklch 0.153) on headings, body, labels and field values

gaps.title: Muted ink lightness
gaps.note: GOV.UK secondary text #484949 (oklch 0.404) on hints and captions

gaps.title: Field and check edges in the text ink
gaps.note: GOV.UK draws a 2px #0b0c0c edge, the text black, on inputs, selects, textareas, checkboxes and radios

gaps.title: Surface hairline strength
gaps.note: GOV.UK lines are #cecece (oklch 0.851) on summary card edges, table rules, tab edges and section breaks
